publications.title: Too Much Information
publications.summary: This article challenges the effectiveness of turning activity based costing information into true cost and capacity information.  ABC suffers from the same problem it attempted to fix; the impact of cost allocations.  As long as allocations exist, especially for activities outside of manufacturing, misunderstandings will continue to exist for those who use the information.

publications.title: Create Bullet-Proof Value Propositions
publications.summary: Uses the concepts in my book Explicit Cost Dynamics as a basis for defining value propositions.  Since ECD is so counter to standard costing and activity based costing, the sources for value creation are often very different.  This shows how to identify and document them.
